title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Bryson LIV Contract Ends
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau's LIV Golf contract expired after the 2026 season finale in Indianapolis, and he posted a cryptic Instagram montage captioned "It was a good run," fueling speculation about his future beyond LIV.

items.headline: Scheffler, McIlroy Chase Money Record
items.text: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy have a chance to surpass Tiger Woods on the PGA Tour’s all-time career money list at the 2026 Tour Championship at East Lake due to the tournament’s large FedEx Cup payouts.

items.headline: Scheffler Tour Championship Favorite
items.text: Scottie Scheffler is the favorite to win the 2026 Tour Championship with a 21% win probability according to Kalshi odds.
